description: P15.04: graph-owned recursive operator generations with immutable ancestry, scoped approval, shared generation work ceilings and recorded rollback.

rules.name: ioa_build_graph_authored_operator_candidate
rules.comment: Build a bounded candidate expression graph from an explicit composition request over the held algebra.

rules.name: ioa_reject_unsafe_composition_request
rules.comment: Reject requests outside the small held-algebra graph grammar; no source code or verifier edits are admitted.

rules.name: ioa_qualify_development_measurement
rules.comment: Development-only positive yield may qualify a candidate when invariant checks are preserved and actual work is within the cap.

rules.name: ioa_reject_unqualified_development_measurement
rules.comment: Reject candidates with nonpositive development gain, proof failures or a changed invariant-check count.

rules.name: ioa_promote_only_with_existing_human_gate
rules.comment: Promotion requires the existing explicit human approval event and the frozen criteria digest; it retains the held parent for rollback.

rules.name: rpi_reserve_one_shared_generation_budget
rules.comment: Reserve one complete generation ceiling from the single shared ThinkingBudget before creating generation state.

rules.name: rpi_record_candidate_generation_before_approval
rules.comment: Bind a graph-authored, development-qualified candidate to one immutable child generation before the human gate.

rules.name: rpi_activate_only_approved_generation
rules.comment: An approved P14 operator promotion activates its matching child generation while retaining frozen ancestry.

rules.name: rpi_suspend_operator_without_funded_generation
rules.comment: An operator cannot remain active if its generation could not reserve the shared work ceiling.

rules.name: rpi_rollback_failed_generation_to_verified_ancestor
rules.comment: Record invariant failure, suspend the child operator and reactivate its direct frozen ancestor.
